purpose: Authoritative runtime labeling for every currently uploaded MOG asset. This file decides what each asset means, where it may appear, what size tier it belongs to, and what it must never be used for.
global_rules: The screenshots/art direction are a reskin reference, not permission to redesign product structure.
Use canonical MOG assets for MOG-owned concepts. Generic SVGs are allowed only for mechanical actions such as close, share, back, camera, edit, search, and add.
Do not use a hero raster as a tiny navigation glyph.
Do not use an asset merely because it looks visually compatible. Its semantic label in this registry controls use.
Do not pulse an entire raster. Animate only named material channels or a dedicated derived mask.
If a required semantic glyph is missing at runtime, leave a documented placeholder and source the approved glyph. Do not invent a substitute.
Legacy is the forged signet ring. Hourglass artwork is explicitly forbidden as Legacy.
App icons are PWA/install identity only and must never be used as ordinary in-app icons.

tiers.system: PWA/browser/install identity. Not normal in-app content.
tiers.control: 32-72px branded glyph/badge used inside an existing control or compact card.
tiers.hero: 96px+ rendered art used sparingly for a principal section or ceremonial moment.
tiers.lockup: Brand wordmark/identity composition, not a button icon.
